cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Admit It Wasn’t Fair
cards.instruction: Get an apology that acknowledges how the rules, comparison, or outcome worked against you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. Could you apologise for judging my cake after everyone knew it was mine?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. You introduced it as 'another interesting attempt.'

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then apologise for encouraging the judges before they'd tasted it.
